errors.evidence: The approximate value for SFT in the Marco-o1-7B chart is stated as 2.0, but the bar clearly extends beyond 2.0 to approximately 2.1.
The approximate value for Baseline in the QwQ-32B-Preview chart is stated as 6.0, but the bar extends visibly beyond the 6-minute mark to approximately 6.2.
The approximate value for SFT in the QwQ-32B-Preview chart is stated as 6.0, but the bar ends before the 6-minute mark, at approximately 5.8 or 5.9. It is also visibly shorter than the Baseline bar.

errors.text_span: sorted in the same order for both models
errors.evidence: The term "sorted" implies an ordering based on value (length of the bars), but the bars are not sorted by length. The categories are simply presented in the same fixed order in both charts. This phrasing is imprecise.

errors.text_span: The O1-Pruner bar is visually distinct due to its blue color
errors.evidence: This is a subjective interpretation. All bars have distinct colors as per the legend, and there is no special visual emphasis (e.g., highlighting) applied to the blue bar to make it more distinct than the others.
